description: TraLogFin: Track a Day, Log a Ticket and Find a Link. One folder, two repositories: development-portfolio_4.00 (public) and backend-architecture_2.00 (private).

scripts.//: AI Code: Review Please 2026-11-23 · preapp runs before every npm run app: it writes the .git file (gitdir: .frontend.git) when it's missing, so VS Code's Source Control finds the front end again. A plain clone's .git folder is left alone
scripts.preapp: node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(!fs.existsSync('.git')&&fs.existsSync('.frontend.git')){fs.writeFileSync('.git','gitdir: .frontend.git\n');console.log('|--🠊 Guidance: .git was missing, written again so VS Code sees the front end, preapp 🠈--|')}"
